changeSet.sql: create table mail_eingang ( message_id text not null constraint mail_eingang_pk primary key, absender text, betreff text, status text not null constraint mail_eingang_status_ck check (status in ('ERFASST', 'QUARANTAENE')), zeit timestamptz not null default clock_timestamp(), dokument_ids uuid[] not null default '{}' ); create index mail_eingang_zeit_ix on mail_eingang (zeit)
